basic_info.description: Discover the charm of 535 Girard Street, a classic single-family home in San Francisco's vibrant Portola neighborhood. Built in 1906, this remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence spans 1,125 square feet and sits on a generous 2,996-square-foot lot. The home features a large kitchen and living room area adjacent to each other and a flexible layout with three bedrooms upstairs and 1 bonus room on the lower level, and an expansive backyard with potential for future development. Brand new roof, new windows, new appliances, newly painted, new fencing in the backyard, and electrical upgrades. Conveniently located near Highways 280 and 101, this property offers a perfect blend of historic charm, modern comfort, and investment potential. Walking distance to the vibrant San Bruno Avenue shopping and dining district. From McLaren Park to schools and transportation options, everything you need is within reach. More photos coming soon!
